summary: Frontend verification of Iter 220p1 CRM Gym/Corporate signup + master-admin work. All three deliverables PASS: (1) TrialSignupModal CRM mode picker — trial-crm-mode block appears when CRM module selected (and is pre-selected by the generic 'Start free trial' CTA which defaults to ALL modules); shows three options (gym/corporate/both) with default 'gym' (aria-pressed=true), clicking each correctly flips aria-pressed and de-selects the others; deselecting the CRM module hides the block; reselecting brings it back. (2) Master Admin → Organisations → Pulse Fitness → Modules tab — both module-crm-leisure-toggle-<id> and module-crm-business-toggle-<id> render with initial aria-checked=true; toggling each OFF then ON triggers a 'Features updated — changes take effect on users' next login or page reload' toast every time (4/4 toasts captured); state persists on full reload (leisure=true, business=true). (3) Org list — org-crm-mode-badge-1e3fb1af-... renders text 'CRM: Both' for Pulse Fitness both before and after the toggle exercise. Pulse left with BOTH Gym (leisure) and Corporate (business) ON, as required.
critical_code_review_comments: TrialSignupModal.js — crmMode payload is conditionally sent only when CRM is in selectedModules (line 170 `crm_mode: selectedModules.includes('crm') ? crmMode : undefined`). Good: no orphan crm_mode leaks when CRM is deselected.

Default selection 'gym' is hard-coded in useState; if marketing later wants a CRM-only landing where 'both' is the default, this would need to be parameterised via the openTrial event detail. Not a blocker.

Master Admin success toast wording is 'Features updated — changes take effect on users' next login or page reload' — clearer than a bare 'Features updated' and matches what the original spec asked for. Resolves the prior iteration's concern (220p1_corporate_toggle) about the toast not rendering — it does render via [data-sonner-toast]/[role=status].
